title: Enquirer’s Guide: Is this the same world we have always known?
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “Is this the same world we have always known?”
Alderwick still has streets, shops, newspapers, and ordinary weather. The discovery of the Stratum added a difficult new field of science; it did not replace familiar life.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
